Good to know

Questions we hear a lot.

Do I need to bring my own clients?

Nope. That's the whole point of Great Clips® — the customers are already coming. You focus on great cuts.

What license do I need?

An active cosmetology or barber license in NC or SC, depending on the salon. Still in school? Ask about Stylist in Training.

I'm a brand-new grad. Is that okay?

More than okay — we hire new grads regularly and pair you with paid training and a mentor.

How does pay work?

A guaranteed hourly base, 100% of your tips, and performance bonuses on top. Exact numbers depend on role and salon.

Can this become a career?

Yes. We promote from within — all of our managers started behind the chair.

A family-owned group of Great Clips® salons serving the greater Charlotte area. Come grow with us.
